## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit messages (`feat(scope): ...`, `fix(scope): ...`)
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour and edge cases
- [ ] `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` passes
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, file format) where relevant
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-facing changes
- [ ] Breaking changes (including file-format changes) documented with a migration note
